sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Find the white object
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'W':
        boundary = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
        cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
        print(f"White object: rows={min(rows)}-{max(rows)} cols={min(cols)}-{max(cols)} hash={n['hash']}")
    
    if n['color'] == 'p':
        boundary = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
        cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
        print(f"Purple object: rows={min(rows)}-{max(rows)} cols={min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Try clicking on the white area
white_obj = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W'][0]
boundary = white_obj['boundary']
rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
center_r = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
center_c = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
print(f"\nClicking white at ({center_r}, {center_c})")

result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c}])
print(f"Click white: level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")

seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
greens = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
player = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
print(f"After click: greens={len(greens)} player={player['boundary']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
